name: spinlog
description: A zero-runtime-dependency, ESM-only terminal color and spinner primitive capped at 1,228 bytes gzipped.
author: spinlog contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:types
scripts.check:phase0: npm run check:phase-map && npm run test:phase0 && node scripts/check-phase0.mjs
scripts.check:phase1: npm run check:phase-map && npm run policy:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && node scripts/check-phase1.mjs && npm run size && npm run size:limit && npm run pack:check
scripts.check:phase1:release: npm run sbom && npm run sbom:check && node scripts/check-phase1-release.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run policy:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run size && npm run size:limit && npm run pack:check
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run sbom && npm run sbom:check
